name: Kenku
description: The map we found showed the entrance to the Priest King's treasure cache right in the middle of the ruined section of the city. We approached our destination without issue, but as we arrived at the burned-out building, a sudden cacophony erupted around us. Birds squawked, cats hissed, and dogs growled. Lidda hustled us back to the city's safer avenues. Only when we were back within the area patrolled by the guard did she explain that the noises indicated that the wingless folk had claimed that area, and that to trespass would be to court death.

features.name: Ability Score Increase
features.description: Your Dexterity score increases by 2, and your Wisdom score increases by 1.

features.name: Age
features.description: Kenku have shorter lifespans than humans. They reach maturity at about 12 years old and can live to 60.

features.name: Size
features.description: Kenku are around 5 feet tall and weigh between 90 and 120 pounds. Your size is Medium.

features.name: Speed
features.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

features.name: Expert Forgery
features.description: You can duplicate other creatures' handwriting and craftwork. You have advantage on all checks made to produce forgeries or duplicates of existing objects.

features.name: Kenku Training
features.description: You are proficient in your choice of two of the following skills: Acrobatics, Deception, Stealth, and Sleight of Hand.

features.name: Mimicry
features.description: You can mimic sounds you have heard, including voices. A creature that hears the sounds you make can tell they are imitations with a successful Wisdom (Insight) check opposed by your Charisma (Deception) check.
